# SemanticOps

> SemanticOps builds SRS (Semantic Record System, pronounced "source"): an open standard for portable semantic documents that people and AI can both understand and use. Knowledge moves intact, so anyone can inspect it, move it and keep using it without depending on the system that created it.

## Start here

- [What SRS is](/agents/home.md): The purpose, the idea and the worked example in one page.
- [The model](/agents/model.md): Field, Type, Package, Note, Record, Relation and Container, each with real JSON from the sample.
- [Patterns](/agents/patterns.md): Four situations where records beat prose, with the mechanism for each.
- [Try the sample](/try/meeting.srs): Unpack it, run srs repo validate and srs repo map, then read the same facts as records.
- [Principles](/agents/principles.md): The scope test and the rules behind the design.
- [Agent memory skill](https://skill.semanticops.com/srs-memory/SKILL.md): A skill that keeps a codebase's decisions, conventions and known traps in an SRS repository, with its setup script, session hook and package beside it.

## Pages

- [Home](/agents/home.md): SRS is an open standard for portable semantic documents that people and AI can both understand and use. This site is generated from the records of an SRS repository. ([JSON](/agents/home.json))
- [Model](/agents/model.md): The SRS model in order: Field, Type, Package, Note, Record, Relation, Container, repository, validation, rendering and identity, each with a real example. ([JSON](/agents/model.json))
- [Patterns](/agents/patterns.md): Four ordinary situations where meaning gets lost in prose, and what SRS does about each, mechanism by mechanism. ([JSON](/agents/patterns.json))
- [Architecture](/agents/architecture.md): How SRS is layered: a standard independent of any implementation, one core consumed identically by every client, and tool-enforced contracts for agents. ([JSON](/agents/architecture.json))
- [Principles](/agents/principles.md): The purpose, the governing core, the pairs SRS holds without settling, and the scope test that keeps the standard small. ([JSON](/agents/principles.json))
- [Projects](/agents/projects.md): The four SemanticOps projects as kinds of technology: the standard, the reference engine, the browser editor and the VS Code extension. ([JSON](/agents/projects.json))

## Data

- [Source repository](/agents/semanticops.srs): The records behind every page, as one portable SRS archive.
- [Repository index](/agents/agent-index.md): The index of that repository for SRS clients, as generated by srs.
- [Page JSON](/agents/home.json): Each /agents/<page>.json is a rendered projection: ordered flat records with field values and depends-on links, without type and field definitions, aiGuidance, containers and depth, compositions, the manifest, relation ids or $schema. For the full repository, unpack /agents/semanticops.srs.
- [Sample repository](/try/meeting.srs): A small real SRS repository: a meeting note, the decision taken from it and two tasks. Its people view is /try/meeting.md.
